UHP_BASE_URL.description: Configured UHP server base URL; absent means disconnected

UHP_MODEL.description: Optional explicit initial model choice; pair with UHP_HARNESS_ID

HINDSIGHT_BASE_URL.description: Configured Hindsight server base URL; absent means degraded memory

FOREMAN_WORKSPACE_SOURCE_REPO.description: Local Git source repository used for pinned Worker snapshot verification

FOREMAN_WORKSPACE_BRIDGE_URL.description: Loopback URL for the external workspace bridge

FOREMAN_WORKSPACE_ALLOWED_SCOPE.description: Comma-separated exact paths or directory prefixes ending in / allowed for Worker changes

FOREMAN_VALIDATION_COMMANDS.description: JSON array of validation command objects {name, command, args, cwd?, network?} with explicit command and args. network is true or false (no other value is accepted): validation commands run without network access unless it is true. When omitted, a pnpm, npm or yarn install (first argument install, i, ci or add, or bare yarn) defaults to true and every other command to false

FOREMAN_VALIDATION_SANDBOX.description: bwrap runs every validation command inside a bubblewrap sandbox and fails closed when it is unavailable; none runs them unsandboxed on the host (unsafe opt-out)

FOREMAN_VALIDATION_SANDBOX_RO_PATHS.description: Comma-separated absolute paths (for example a toolchain under your home directory) mounted read-only into the validation sandbox
